visual_plan: style: FLAT skin for the whole reel (series look). Settings: the same office's meeting room (whiteboard with a plain rising arrow, no logos) and the manager's glass cabin. Silent continuity eggs: 'SECONDARY ⭐' sticky on Ramesh's laptop lid; the Ep 1 garland on the cabin door. Freeze frames = still + white flash pop + slight desaturation.

CAST (office_cast.js from content/2026-11-23-comedy-manager-mind-game/2d/, unchanged): MANAGER = makeManager; RAMESH = makeRamesh; SURESH = makeSuresh (silent here: nods and claps hardest); extras = makeColleague(0..2). NEW one-off BOSS: voice only, never drawn; on screen just the manager's phone on speaker with a caller card 'BOSS 📞' and a grey silhouette avatar. Priya not in this episode. Gopi: corner cut-out for his line only.
Intro 0.0–0.6 s (no voice): text hook 'Project నాది… Credit ఎవరిది? 🤨'; slow-mo villain walk into the meeting room.
L1: arms wide at the table; DHOOM on 'గైస్!'; limp claps (Suresh claps hardest, bobble nod).
L2: Ramesh raises his hand; flashback chip: Ramesh coding at 2 AM, clock '2:00 AM'.
L3: the manager pats his head; Ramesh's name chip 'RAMESH' gets sucked into a big 'TEAM' bubble.
L4: flashback chip: Ramesh juggling three ringing phones at night.
L5: the manager taps his temple, a cheesy lightbulb 'VISION 💡' over his head; team 'ooooh?!'. Whoosh to the cabin; FOLLOW button pops in and is tapped (silent follow beat).
L6: the manager on the phone, chest out; Ramesh standing right beside him; on 'successfully!' crash-zoom on Ramesh's jaw drop, FAAAH #1.
L7: the phone on speaker, caller card 'BOSS 📞' glows; 'KA-CHING' and a gold 'BONUS ✨' shimmer round the manager.
L8–L9: Ramesh's schoolboy hand; the manager covers the mouthpiece, annoyed.
L10: Ramesh counts on his fingers: chips '1. PROJECT: రమేష్' → '2. CREDIT: మేనేజర్' → '3. INCREMENT: ???'.

L11 punch: the manager, proud and straight-faced; the '???' chip flips to 'COMPANY 🏢'; FREEZE on 'రమేష్!'. PAUSE 1.5 s: reaction shot = Ramesh laugh-crying (😭😂: tears squirting sideways while he laughs), sad trombone, tuba sting, laugh.
ENDING CARD (owner's text, verbatim, ~3 s), three beats with a stamp each: 'పని మనది...' → 'పేరు మేనేజర్‌ది...' → 'లాభం కంపెనీది!'.
